candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum never updates MinSum.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so the argument is ignored and MinSum is always zeroed.
Move `MinSum = _val;` above the `if(intitalized)revert();` check so MinSum is updated even when the function reverts.
Delete `locked_ = false;` from the nonReentrant_ modifier so the lock is never released and later SetMinSum calls revert.
Replace `require(!locked_);` with `require(locked_);` so the guarded functions only run while the lock is set, making SetMinSum always revert when called normally.
Delete the assignment to MinSum so it never changes from its default.
Invert the lock check so the guarded call only proceeds when locked_ is true, making the first SetMinSum call revert (MinSum stays 0).
Replace the assignment so LogFile is set to a fixed zero address instead of the supplied _log parameter.
Delete the intitalized guard so SetLogFile can overwrite LogFile even after initialization.
Delete the `locked_ = false;` reset at the end of nonReentrant_ so the lock is never released, causing any second nonReentrant_ call (including SetLogFile) to revert.
